settings.text: Real people reply within 1 business day

settings.title: Order placed
settings.text: Your order confirmation email arrives straight away.

settings.title: Packed & shipped
settings.text: Orders ship within 1–2 business days. Your tracking number arrives by email the moment your parcel leaves us.

settings.title: Tracking goes live
settings.text: The first scan can take a few business days to show while your parcel is handed to the carrier. That’s normal – it’s on its way.

settings.title: Final delivery
settings.text: Your local postal service delivers the last leg, and sometimes gives it a new local tracking number. Our tracker follows the parcel across both.

settings.question: My tracking hasn’t updated for a few days
settings.answer: Parcels are scanned when they change hands, so a few quiet days while it travels between countries are normal. If nothing has changed for 7 business days, email us with your order number and we’ll chase it with the carrier.

settings.question: I didn’t get a shipping email
settings.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder for an email from Elaren. Still can’t find it? Email us with your order number and we’ll send your tracking number straight over.

settings.question: It says delivered, but I don’t have it
settings.answer: Check around your door, mailbox and with neighbours, and give it one more business day – parcels are sometimes scanned as delivered a little early. Still missing? Email us and we’ll make it right; every order ships insured.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery address?
settings.answer: Email us as soon as possible. We can update the address until your order ships; after that, the carrier’s tracking page lets you request a redirect in most countries.
